repositories.name: ceortpsc/rtpsc-backoffice-full-integration-module
repositories.integrationRule: All imports and data exchanges must pass through an anti-corruption adapter. No direct production dependency is allowed until package metadata, tests, security and versioning are normalized.

repositories.name: ceortpsc/theapplianceclinic
repositories.relationship: client-commissioned application developed and maintained as a separate customer system
responsibilities: customer, order, invoice and payment workflows
repair, pickup, delivery and service operations
employee, scheduling, payroll and back-office administration
repositories.dataBoundary: Client business and store-operational data must remain segregated from RTPSC taxpayer, tax-practice, ERO and professional-client records.
repositories.integrationRule: This is an independently governed client platform, not an RTPSC internal vertical. No taxpayer or tax-practice data sharing is permitted. Only generalized, reviewed and non-confidential engineering patterns or packages may be reused across systems.
